title: The 'name it (stands down)' pacify ability doesn't always unlock a blocked path immediately — at Barrow Crypt naming the wight/rats instantly opened the north passage, but at The Waiting Bough naming the gray sergeant left the way 'locked' and still required a separate will/grace check afterward. Inconsistent payoff for the same-looking ability made it unclear what 'stood down' actually guarantees.
where: Barrow Crypt vs. The Waiting Bough (Thornwold)
